prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding tips and a timer to waiting screens was helpful (+8.9%, p=0.0008), closely matching predictions (+8.0%).
Redesigning or updating layouts for path choice and intro screens was helpful (+12.0% for split view redesign, +4.2% for story scroll layout).
New flows and certain new screens can be harmful; a post-setup launcher flow (-19.6%, p=0.001) and customization style preview screen (-9.1%, p=0.017) significantly hurt performance.
Copy changes, hints, step reordering, status indicators, notification toggles, and animations showed no clear effect.
Predictions for path choice and layout improvements were too low.
Predictions for new flows, new screens, step reordering, hints, and copy changes were consistently too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +5.9% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: -7.0% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +3.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -2.5% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +4.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +12.0% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: +8.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -6.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -2.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: +3.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.2% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -1.2% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 86.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Layout Pet Selection Redesign: Redesign the pet pick screen using a carousel layout featuring large interactive pet preview components. (why: Adoption conversion drops significantly to 60.9% with high mean time (1017s); layout improvements proved effective in earlier tests.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Pet Adoption: Move the sign-in screen to occur after pet selection and adoption certificate step, right before pet generation starts. (why: Sign-in loses 27.1% of users early; letting users pick and name their pet first builds engagement before asking for account sign-in.)
2: [home, redesign] Full Bleed Waiting Screen Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a full bleed layout with an integrated tip carousel component and timer display. (why: The waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s; previous results showed +8.9% lift from tips/timers and strong gains from layout redesigns.)
3: [finish, redesign] Split View Home Welcome Screen Redesign: Rebuild the home_intro welcome screen using a split layout displaying the mascot side-by-side with getting started actions. (why: The finish step drops 35.2% of users; layout redesigns showed up to +12% conversion increase in prior tests.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-Generation Adoption Summary Screen: Insert a new summary screen right before pet generation to review selected pet traits and photo uploads. (why: Support mailbox received 3 complaints about custom pet creation failing or resulting in visual errors due to unexpected upload choices.)
5: [home, notification] Notification Toggle on Pet Ready: Enable desktop notification switch on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet generation finishes. (why: Mean home waiting time is 2336s (39 minutes); notifying users when ready prevents dropping off during long background renders.)
6: [choose_path, redesign] Card Layout Story Intro Redesign: Redesign the story intro screen to a card layout featuring an animated desktop pet mascot component. (why: Intro layout updates previously delivered strong results (+4.2% story scroll, +12.0% split view redesign).)
7: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Tip Guidance: Add photo quality guidance hints and visual preview guides on the upload_photos screen. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect due to photo input issues.)
8: [sign_in, copy] Account Reconnection Clarification Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to clarify that existing pets and progress will be safely synced upon signing in. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into an existing account.)
9: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Completion Badge Incentive: Display progress indicators and an official pet adoption badge component on the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption step conversion is low at 60.9%; visual badges provide positive motivation right before generation starts.)
